{{Quote|&hellip;And, I am ''hardly'' alone. As you can see, I have an army!|King Ommin|<ref name="TOTJA" />}}
The '''Naddist army''' was the name given to the military force that [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Amanoa]] commanded against the [[Beast-Lord]]s [[Modon Kira|Modon]] and [[Oron Kira]] and his [[Beast Riders]], during [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon's]] [[Beast Wars|Beast War conflict]] of [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]]. The [[Army/Legends|army]] consisted of [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]-wielding [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]], dark side [[Dark side adept/Legends|adepts]], battalions of [[darksider]]s, and [[Naddist]] troops, as well as regular [[Onderon/Legends|Onderonian]] soldiers that comprised the bulk of the infantry. The army appeared to be predominantly [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|males]], though several of the Dark Jedi commanders were female. By [[3998 BBY]] the army had been further augmented by the addition of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith Elite Warbot|war]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. The Naddist army was also disbanded later that year, since all of its members and factions were eliminated during the [[Freedon Nadd Uprising]].

==History==
===Beast Wars===
{{Main|Beast Wars}}

[[File:OmminAleemaSatal.jpg|thumb|left|200px|King Ommin with members of his incarnation of the Naddist army.]]

In [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]], the Naddist army, captained by Amanoa's [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Novar (Human)|Novar]], went to [[Battle of Iziz|war]] against the Beast Riders of Onderon. During the battle, Amanoa employed ancient Sith [[Sith sorcery/Legends|techniques]] to bolster the strength of her army's military tactics against the Beast Riders. However, intervention on the part of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]], led by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Arca Jeth]], quickly turned the tide of battle and delivered victory into the hands of the Beast Riders. Through use of ancient ''Jedi'' [[Battle meditation/Legends|techniques]], Jeth was able to revive the Beast Riders' morale while diminishing the will to fight of the darksiders.<ref name="BWOO" />

===Freedon Nadd Uprising===
{{Main|Freedon Nadd Uprising}}

[[3998 BBY|Two years later]], a new dark side army surfaced, under the direct command of Amanoa's husband, the [[Sith sorcerer|sorcerer]] [[King/Legends|King]] [[Ommin/Legends|Ommin]]. This new army went to [[Freedon Nadd Uprising|war]] against the Jedi, again led by Arca Jeth, and the full might of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]]. King Ommin made heavy use of his Sith war droids in the ensuing battle, and his military commander, a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] named [[Warb Null]], led the ground troops from the front lines. Arca Jeth and his team of Knights defeated Ommin's army again, using the same Jedi battle meditation technique that was employed in the last war. With the [[Death/Legends|death]] of King Ommin, his Dark Side Army was also wiped out, and peace restored on Onderon.<ref name="FNU" />

==Organization of forces==
There was a solid chain of command implemented in the Naddist army. The supreme commander was by right the monarch of Iziz, and through said King or Queen, orders were disseminated through the ranks. During the reign of Amanoa, direct military command was given to the Royal advisor [[Novar (Human)|Novar]], who managed the theater of war while overseeing the progress of the Naddist troops in battle. Occasionally, Novar would join the fray, and engage the enemy alongside his subordinates.<ref name="TOTJA" />

===Infantry===
The Naddist army consisted of many different ranks and factions. During the reign of Queen Amanoa, the ranks were comprised mainly of [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[Dark side adept/Legends|adepts]], individuals who worshiped the memory of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] [[Freedon Nadd]].<ref name="TOTJA" /> Officers led from the front lines, with [[Commander/Legends|commanders]] stationed along the walls of Iziz, as well as in the thick of things on ground. Snipers were also secreted throughout the city, in places that made it difficult for enemy forces to advance through the streets.<ref name="BWOO" />

===Amanoa's bodyguards===
{{Main|Royal Protector}}
{{Quote|Guards! Defend us!|Queen Amanoa, to her Royal protectors|<ref name="TOTJA" />}}
[[File:CayLosesHisArm.jpg|thumb|right|150px|A Royal protector severs the arm of Jedi Knight Cay Qel-Droma.]]

Though the Queen's Royal advisor [[Novar (Human)|Novar]] commanded most of the forces directly, a special cadre of dark side adepts was specifically commissioned to serve and protect the Queen.<ref name="TOTJA" /> These [[Royal Protector]]s were clad in all white [[Armor/Legends|armor]], and wore flowing cloaks; neither of which seemed to restrict their movement. Their heads and faces were fully enclosed in their helmets, and a visor allowed the Protectors to view their surroundings. They carried bladed, staff-type weapons, and wielded them with considerable efficiency in combat,<ref name="BWOO" /> in conjunction with the [[Blaster pistol/Legends|ranged energy weapons]] they used when engaging in [[Lightfight|firefights]] with the enemy.<ref name="TOTJA" />

===Wave gunners===
{{Main|Wave gunner}}

Naddist wave gunners were soldiers who specialized in the operation of Iziz's outside wall defenses. From these [[Iziz defense tower|defense towers]], the wave gunners unleashed both [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] and [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] fire against incoming air ''and'' ground attacks. They too wore full-body white armor, and helmets with visors to shield their eyes from the blinding discharge of the cannons and lasers. Though their trappings afforded them basic protection in combat, a few well-placed blaster bolts could penetrate the plates, and kill the individual inside.
